name: Catacombs Far Lower Foundations B source

provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: second production camera-relative parallax background variation for a side-view 2D exploration platformer; one far-depth lower-foundation companion layer.
Primary request: Create exactly one coherent connected architectural formation, compositionally distinct from a broad rectilinear ossuary facade. Emphasize collapsed buttressed substructures, broad staggered stone terraces, several sealed low vault doors, eroded stair-like foundations, broken retaining ribs, and irregular rubble-filled recesses. Do not create a large rectangular building face or evenly spaced window grid.
Canvas/output: exactly one opaque PNG, target 960 x 540 pixels (16:9, 960:540). Fill the canvas with the environment composition except for the required lateral removal-matte gutters. No text, UI, border, picture frame, or watermark.
Layer/matte requirements: This is a transparent-overlay production layer encoded against a deterministic chroma-key matte. Every background pixel must be exactly flat solid #FF00FF, RGBA (255, 0, 255, 255), with no gradients, noise, shadow, texture, fringe, color variation, or near-magenta substitutes in any background area. The outermost 7% of canvas width on both left and right must be completely empty uniform #FF00FF removal matte from top edge to bottom edge (approximately 67 pixels each side at 960px width). Absolutely no subject pixel, shadow, debris, glow, antialiasing fringe, or texture may enter either lateral gutter or touch either lateral image edge. Taper the connected masonry into irregular rubble immediately before each gutter. The identical solid-magenta left and right edges must make horizontal repetition seamless and support 96-pixel overlap with neighboring layers.
Composition/framing: Side-on orthographic game-art view. The connected formation occupies the central 86% width. Its irregular upper masonry contour begins within the top 4% of the canvas, and its dense foundation mass ends within the bottom 4%; no large unused matte bands above or below in the occupied central region. Keep the architecture broad, low-profile, horizontally layered, weighty, and never tower-like. Use an asymmetrical rhythm: one side dominated by collapsed diagonal buttress remnants and terraced slabs, the other by low sealed vaults, broken retaining ribs, uneven stair foundations, and rubble-filled cavities. Maintain a single connected silhouette; no detached floating objects. No floor plane.
Style/medium: Crisp hand-authored 16-bit pixel art for a production game asset. Chunky deliberate pixel clusters, hard pixel edges, limited palette, strong silhouettes, broad readable value groups, authentic low-resolution pixel construction. No smoothing, no antialiasing, no painterly brushwork, no blur, no soft vector edges, no photorealism.
Lighting/mood: Cold dim subterranean atmosphere with restrained upper-left illumination. Pale blue highlights only on selected upper-left stone edges; deep shadowed recesses remain legible as broad shapes.
Color palette: Architecture only in dark navy and indigo stone, desaturated blue-purple midtones, restrained pale blue highlights. Background/removal areas only exact #FF00FF.
Materials/textures: Ancient chipped stone courses, fractured slabs, eroded masonry, collapsed rubble and worn foundation steps, represented through purposeful chunky clusters rather than fine noise.
Gameplay readability: Preserve strong silhouettes and a few broad value tiers; keep low vault doors sealed and squat. Formation must read clearly at far parallax depth.
Constraints: exactly one image and one connected subject; horizontally tile-compatible via identical empty matte gutters; no pixels at lateral edges; architecture nearly full height only within occupied central region.
Avoid: broad rectilinear ossuary facade; large rectangular building face; evenly spaced windows or grid; tall arches; full-height columns; ceilings; towers or vertical spires; repeated skull emblems; characters; creatures; props; floor plane; text; letters; numbers; UI; border; frame; watermark; painterly blur; smoothing; antialiasing; glows spilling into gutters; detached objects; visible subject pixels in lateral gutters; large unused top or bottom bands.
